## Change

Describe the scoped change and link its issue. State any deliberate non-goals.

## Verification

List checks actually performed and their results. Explain unrun checks and known limitations. For behavioral changes, describe the synthetic scenarios exercised.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope matches the issue and roadmap, without unrelated features.
- [ ] Module boundaries and affected documentation are preserved or updated.
- [ ] Relevant behavioral acceptance criteria are covered, or this is documentation-only.
- [ ] No private client data, credentials, keys, or real exported bundles are included.
